added: Dances imported from The Caller's Box now recognize "two-hand turn" however it is written (hyphenated or not, partner before or after) and "Ones arch, twos dive", instead of keeping those lines as unrecognized text. A stated turn direction, which a two-hand turn has no setting for, is kept as a note.

The shared figure recognizer reads `two-hand turn` (hyphenated, subject before or after, spin words and a trailing `and face …` kept as the note) as `two_hand_turn`, and `<ones|twos> arch, <twos|ones> dive` as `arch_and_dive` with the arching pair as `who`.
